title: Serialize supplier comparison single and batch procurement conversion
description: Stage3 core business workflow integrity. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Implement single and batch conversion with shared existing transaction protocol: deterministically lock resolved authoritative owning sales orders before source quote rows where applicable, reread immutable batch membership, live permissions, source availability, selected approved decision/supplier, master references, quantity/price/units, recognized currency and destination PurchaseSalesOrderLinkRules before number generation and writes. Reject unknown currency rather than defaulting CNY. Explicit ambiguous/deleted/unavailable ownership remains controlled and cannot silently create a differently owned order. Coordinate locks with previous quote CRUD/decision task and existing sales cancellation/ordinary procurement order protocol.

One committed generated order lineage per eligible source row for competing single/single, single/batch and overlapping batch calls; loser gets controlled stale/duplicate outcome with no orphan or partial orders. Preserve compatible grouping, ineligible line explicit skip semantics within authorized scope and first committed conversion evidence. A failure after any group/detail/line write rolls back complete conversion. Exact source markers and decision reference remain, source quantities/prices/approved terms unchanged. Prefill/plan stay read-only and cannot reserve numbers or change decisions.

Preserve per-order currency/unit accounting and remove or make explicitly unknown cross-currency batch aggregate TotalAmount; update existing nested DTO contracts in PurchaseQuoteConversion.cs and purchase-order-conversion.js batchPlanText to show totals separated by currency without mixed sum, never present mixed currency sum as money. Two independent genuine SQL connections test competing single and overlapping batches, source edit/approval/deletion and owning sales cancellation, unknown currency, invalid supplier/product/unit/master and forced mid-batch failure. Check exactly generated headers/details/source links, no inventory/finance writes, correct destination authorization and server totals. Relevant existing units, new real SQL tests and safe Release/full unit.

implementation_evidence: PurchaseQuoteController.ToPurchaseOrder performs load/build/number/add/MarkConverted/save with no shared transaction/quote lock. PurchaseQuoteConversion.ConvertBatchAsync builds untracked rows then separately re-queries tracked rows and writes without rereading eligibility under locks. Single versus batch conversion can both create orders; approval checks survive supplier/terms changes. ParseCurrency silently falls back CNY and batch TotalAmount sums different currency groups. ERP020/027 unit guards do not provide SQL concurrency integrity. Existing purchase-order-conversion.js batchPlanText displays plan.totalAmount as one money total across all groups; nested plan/result DTOs reside in PurchaseQuoteConversion.cs.
